title: Wardrobe flourish, a calmer menu and Settings, in-app update
description: She now comes up with a two-second wardrobe flourish, the right-click menu and Settings are reorganised under one monochrome theme that follows macOS light and dark, and the app can download, verify and install its own updates.
highlights: Wardrobe flourish: each time your avatar comes up or you switch character she flashes through her outfits, hair, skin tones and colours for about two seconds, then settles on the look you chose. Nothing she flashes through is saved and props are never part of it. Turn it off in Settings › Appearance or View › Wardrobe Flourish.

The right-click menu is grouped: talk and Ask… on top; Perform, Look, Character, Agent and View in the middle; Avatar Show, Settings, updates and the installed version at the bottom. About moved into Check for Updates….

Settings is a sidebar of panes with a one-line status each, saves as you change it, and shares one monochrome theme with the Avatar Show panel, bubbles and the updates window. Everything follows the macOS light or dark appearance.

In-app update: Check, Download with progress, then Install and Relaunch. The installer is checked against its published checksum, the developer’s signature and Apple’s notarization before anything is replaced, and the old version goes to the Trash.

Fixes: a character whose saved look kept a weapon grip after the prop was put away (Tia aiming an empty hand) now comes up standing, and Props › None lets go of the grip. The Enclosed and Heavy Seraphim armors are retired. The Avatar Show panel is tighter: the topic is a suggestion, How it works is a drawer.
